parent_objective: design public no-training candidate generation using the T4/T5 decisive-history harness
blocked_by: the metadata harness exists, but current-sim candidate generation and matching sources are not yet designed
supersedes: direct candidate-generation smoke without source/matching design
training or replay before candidate generation is source-diverse and control-clean

public_gates: M1501 must design no-training T4/T5 current-sim candidate generation
M1501 must name public seeds, source families, matching tolerances, and diversity gates
M1501 must preserve the actor input contract
M1501 must block training replay PPO promotion private holdout and corpus export
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run candidate generation before the design is explicit

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the no-training path from current-sim sources into T4/T5 candidate rows
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, PPO, replay, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if source families cannot create matched current/recent candidates
stop if candidate generation depends on forbidden actor inputs
stop if source-diversity and current/recent matching gates are not explicit
stop if design starts replay or training
fallback_plan: if T4 generation is too hard, design T5 terminal-boundary generation first
if both require new simulator hooks, route to a no-training env-hook implementation
if current sim cannot support decisive candidates honestly, record a simulator-scope blocker

admission_evidence: M1500 implemented T4/T5 metadata harness and focused tests
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up no-training candidate-generation smoke manifest

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1501 designs candidate generation that explicitly controls current and recent-window substitution; it does not produce self-ID evidence.
history_necessity_tests: design T4 same-current same-recent older-history candidate generation
design T5 near-boundary terminal-margin candidate generation
design required current-tiled reset wrong delayed controls
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: design only; no new temporal evidence generated.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If current-sim candidate generation cannot construct T4/T5 without shortcuts, record that blocker before training or replay.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The decisive-history harness can be connected to a public no-training current-sim candidate-generation route with explicit matching and diversity gates.
success_criteria: design names T4/T5 source families and public seed policy
design blocks training PPO replay promotion private holdout corpus export and actor-input changes
failure_criteria: source families or matching tolerances are omitted
design starts candidate generation replay PPO training promotion corpus export or actor-input change
decision_rule: M1501 passes if it designs a no-training candidate-generation route before any smoke, replay, or training.
